title: SQLite index behind the service's item lookups
description:
Add `internal/index` on `modernc.org/sqlite`, stored under `.underdraw/run/` (gitignored).

- Rebuilt from the `.underdraw/` files on startup if missing or stale; it must never be the source of truth.
- Kept in sync on every service write and reload.
- Serves the queries that are slow in memory today: ListItems filters, next_task candidates, blocking and effective status (both currently scan every item, roughly O(n²)).

Measure first: only switch a query once a benchmark with a few thousand items shows the in-memory version is too slow.
